p1_b1.speaker: pip
p1_b1.text: Hi Fiona! Why are you so bright pink?

p1_b2.speaker: dot
p1_b2.text: You look like sweet cotton candy!

p2_b1.speaker: fiona
p2_b1.text: I am pink because I eat yummy pink shrimp!

p2_b2.speaker: pip
p2_b2.text: Wait! What you eat changes your color?!

p3_b1.speaker: pip
p3_b1.text: Oh no! If I eat green broccoli, will I turn green?!

p3_b2.speaker: dot
p3_b2.text: Haha! Pip, you are an orange cat!

p4_b1.speaker: pip
p4_b1.text: Roar! Look at me! I am the Green Monster Cat!

p4_b2.speaker: dot
p4_b2.text: Haha, silly Pip! Broccoli just makes you strong!

emote_fiona.speaker: fiona
emote_fiona.text: Flap flap! Pink is my favorite color!

fact_fiona.speaker: dot
fact_fiona.text: Why Are Flamingos Pink? Flamingo chicks are actually born with grey and white feathers! They turn bright pink because their favorite food, pink shrimp and red algae, contains a natural pink dye called carotenoids.

quiz_q1.speaker: dot
quiz_q1.text: Why is Fiona the flamingo bright pink?

quiz_q1_correct.speaker: dot
quiz_q1_correct.text: Super job! Flamingos eat lots of pink shrimp, which turns their feathers pink!

quiz_q2.speaker: dot
quiz_q2.text: If Pip the cat eats green broccoli, will he turn green?

quiz_q2_correct.speaker: dot
quiz_q2_correct.text: That's right! Pip will always be an orange cat, but broccoli makes him healthy!

quiz_q3.speaker: dot
quiz_q3.text: What does eating healthy broccoli do for you?

quiz_q3_correct.speaker: dot
quiz_q3_correct.text: Awesome! Green vegetables give you vitamins to make you strong and happy!

quiz_win.speaker: pip
quiz_win.text: Super job! You are a FunFact Animal Champion! Meow and yay!

vocab_pink.speaker: dot
vocab_pink.text: Pink. A sweet color like strawberries and flamingos.

vocab_shrimp.speaker: dot
vocab_shrimp.text: Shrimp. Small pink animals that swim in the water.

vocab_broccoli.speaker: dot
vocab_broccoli.text: Broccoli. A healthy, tree-shaped green vegetable.

vocab_monster.speaker: pip
vocab_monster.text: Monster! A silly, playful green creature! Roar!

vocab_strong.speaker: dot
vocab_strong.text: Strong! Full of power and healthy energy!
